title: Poll VCF Installer proxy updates to a terminal task state
prompt: Implement the exported Set-VcfInstallerProxyConfiguration function in src/VcfInstaller.Proxy.psm1. The runner installs the genuine VMware.Sdk.Vcf.Installer PowerCLI module version 13.5.0.25380678 as an environment prerequisite; use its Initialize-VcfInstallerProxyConfiguration, Invoke-VcfInstallerUpdateProxyConfiguration, and Invoke-VcfInstallerGetTask cmdlets rather than a direct HTTP client. Build the ProxyConfiguration model from the supplied function parameters (ProxyHost has the caller-facing alias Host). Optional properties must be added only when the caller supplied them, including preserving an explicitly supplied false boolean; do not turn an unset host, port, username, password, transferProtocol, or isAuthenticated value into an empty string, zero, false, or null property on the wire. Submit updateProxyConfiguration, take the task id from its 202 response, and poll getTask for that exact id until the status is terminal. Treat PENDING, IN_PROGRESS, and QUEUED (case-insensitively, with spaces normalized to underscores) as non-terminal; return the terminal Task object for SUCCESSFUL, FAILED, CANCELLED, COMPLETED_WITH_WARNING, SKIPPED, or TIMED_OUT. Reject an unexpected status and throw System.TimeoutException when TimeoutSeconds expires. PollIntervalSeconds=0 must be supported for deterministic tests. The public parameter contract already present in the stub must remain compatible. Do not edit the module manifest, docs, or tests. The verifier uses the genuine SDK only against a contract-pinned loopback VCF Installer mock and never contacts a live VMware endpoint.
